name: vscode-updater
description: Automatically update VS Code on Linux

vscode-updater.installPath.description: Custom installation directory for VS Code. Leave empty to auto-detect.

vscode-updater.autoBackup.description: Automatically backup the current installation before updating.

vscode-updater.checkInterval.description: How often to check for updates in days (default: 1).

vscode-updater.channel.description: VS Code release channel to check and download.

vscode-updater.flavour.description: VS Code flavour. Use 'other' to provide custom update and test URLs.

vscode-updater.customUpdateBaseUrl.description: Base URL for update downloads when flavour is 'other'. Example: https://update.example.com

vscode-updater.customReleasesUrl.description: Full URL for releases list when flavour is 'other'. Example: https://update.example.com/api/releases/stable

vscode-updater.customBinaryName.description: Binary name to restart when flavour is 'other'. Leave empty to use 'code'.
